full_prompt_en: A square painterly collage places several overlapping faces and figures inside a thick bright orange border. The dominant image is a young man in side profile on the left, with dark swept hair, a warmly lit brow and cheek, and a serious downward gaze. His face sits against a flat yellow field that continues to the lower left. A white collar and dark green jacket emerge below, partly interrupted by translucent vertical patches. To the right of him, narrower rectangular sections hold other young faces at different scales. A pale blond face appears near the upper center, a red haired face occupies the upper right, and another dark haired figure sits lower in the middle. At the far right, a smaller full figure in a green cap and coat stands against a cool turquoise and pale architectural fragment. The layered sections do not join as one physical room; their straight seams and changed color temperatures announce a montage. Amber, olive green, teal, and saturated cyan brushwork passes across the faces and clothing, while darker marks supply eye and jaw detail. The orange edge remains uninterrupted around the whole image, making the central cluster feel like a print or poster without any legible title. Soft directional highlights illuminate selected cheeks and brows, while other areas fall into broad green brown shade. Edges range from carefully modeled profiles to rough painterly seams where the images overlap. The overall composition is vivid and compressed, using cropped faces, translucent blocks, and opposing warm and cool colors to suggest a layered cinematic story.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形绘画性拼贴将几张重叠的面孔与人物安放在厚实的亮橙色边框里。主要图像是左侧一名年轻男子的侧脸，深色头发向后梳，额头和面颊受暖光照射，神情严肃，目光略向下。脸置于延伸到左下的平坦黄色区域前。白衣领和深绿外套从下方出现，又被半透明的竖向色块部分打断。他右侧，较窄的矩形分区容纳不同尺度的其他年轻面孔。上方中央附近是一张浅金发面孔，右上方有红发面孔，中部较低处还有一名深发人物。最右侧，戴绿帽、穿绿外套的更小全身人物站在冷青色与浅色建筑碎片前。层叠的区域并不拼成一个真实房间；笔直的接缝和变化的色温表明这是蒙太奇。琥珀、橄榄绿、青绿与饱和青蓝笔触横过脸和衣服，较深笔痕提供眼睛与下颌细节。橙色边缘不间断地围住整幅图，使中央群像像一张印刷海报，却没有可读标题。柔和的定向高光照亮选定的面颊和眉骨，别处则落入宽阔的绿褐阴影。边缘从细心塑形的侧脸变化为图像相叠处粗糙的绘画接缝。整体构图鲜烈而紧凑，以裁切的面孔、半透明色块和对立的冷暖色彩暗示层次丰富的电影叙事。
style_prompt_en: Painterly collage assembles multiple cropped image fields at different scales inside a strong saturated border. Warm yellow and orange planes oppose deep olive, teal, and cyan, so color temperature separates overlapping layers as much as drawn edges do. Selective detailed modeling appears beside flat blocks, rough brush seams, and translucent vertical overlays. Some forms are abruptly cut by rectangular boundaries; others bleed softly into adjacent color. A large dominant silhouette anchors one side, with smaller repeated fragments stepping toward the opposite edge. Local highlights pick out small features without requiring a consistent single space or light source across the montage. The surface mixes smooth passages with visible paint drag and grain. The overall effect is cinematic and energetic, driven by compressed scale shifts, graphic framing, and the tension between connected and disconnected images.
style_prompt_zh: 绘画性拼贴在醒目的饱和边框内，把不同尺度的裁切图像区域组合起来。暖黄和橙色平面与深橄榄绿、青绿和青蓝相对，因此冷暖色差与描绘边缘一起分隔重叠层次。有选择的细致塑形与平色色块、粗糙笔触接缝及半透明竖向覆层并置。有些形体被矩形边界突然截断，另一些则柔软地渗入邻近颜色。一侧由较大的主导剪影支撑，较小的重复碎片逐步向对侧排列。局部高光挑出少量细节，却不要求蒙太奇各处共享一个真实空间或统一光源。表面混合平滑区域与可见的拖拽颜料及颗粒。整体效果有电影感且充满动势，由压缩的尺度变化、图形化边框以及图像相连与断开的张力推动。
theme_en: Layered cinematic faces within a bright orange framed collage
theme_zh: 亮橙色边框内层叠的电影式人物面孔拼贴
name: Bob Peak
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
